description: For regular uncountable \(\kappa\), a family of objects in \(V_{\kappa.\mathrm{ord}}\) indexed by a set of cardinality below \(\kappa\) has its specified rank-plus-one supremum below that height. Every output belongs to the stage at that very supremum, and the actual collected range belongs to \(V_{\kappa.\mathrm{ord}}\), including an empty index set.
